DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin or Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma)

The clinical picture of "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss), significant retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy on CT, and elevated LDH is highly suggestive of a lymphoproliferative disorder. While ACE levels are pending to rule out sarcoidosis, the imaging and LDH elevation make malignancy the primary concern. I will proceed with a tissue diagnosis via lymph node biopsy to confirm the specific subtype.
